theme_central: Steadfastness (thabat) in faith facing both intellectual trials (the People of the Book) and material trials (the battle of Uhud).
sources_note: 4-section structure cross-checked on alsalam.ac.uk (Thematic Overview: Surah Al 'Imran) and islamophile.org — corroborated.

branches.title: Fundamental truths
branches.resume: Revealed shortly after Badr: the Book, clear and ambiguous verses, the religion accepted by Allah.

children.t: The Book, unequivocal verses (muhkam) and multi-layered ones (mutashabih), sound vs deviant hearts
Fate of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment, deep longing of the believers
Allah's testimony to His Oneness, the religion accepted by Him is Islam
Warning against rejecting the signs, call to follow the Messenger

branches.title: The family of Imran, dialogue with the Christians
branches.resume: Birth of Maryam and Yahya, annunciation and miracles of Aissa, debate with the delegation of Najran (9 AH).

children.t: Election of the family of Imran, vow and birth of Maryam
Zakariyya and the announcement of the birth of Yahya
Annunciation to Maryam, birth and miracles of Aissa (Jesus)
The disciples, debate with the Christians of Najran, the Mubahala

branches.title: Call to unity, warning against the People of the Book
branches.resume: Common word with the People of the Book, warning against their schemes, the Kaaba, cohesion of the community.

children.t: Call to a common word, exposing the manipulations of the People of the Book
Covenant of the prophets, the true religion, authentic piety
The Kaaba, the first place of worship established, obligation of pilgrimage
Warning against internal discord, alliances not to be formed

branches.title: The battle of Uhud, endurance
branches.resume: A review of the battle of Uhud: the trial, the hypocrites, consolation, final exhortation to patience.

children.t: Preparations before the battle of Uhud
Reminder of the prohibition of riba, exhortation to piety
Course of the trial, the withdrawal of the hypocrites
The martyrs are alive with Allah, consolation in the face of the enemy's plot
Not to be grieved by the respite granted to the disbelievers
Reflection of "those of understanding" (ulul albab), final supplication, exhortation to patience
